reviews.text: This team did an amazing job. From the initial call they were responsive. They arrived promptly designed my beautiful accent tv wall with sconce lights, fireplace and TV and came home yesterday and it exceeded our expectations. They work clean, organized and professional. Thank you Rolando for the quality work.
reviews.author: Robert Butmankiewicz
reviews.note: Trailing dangling signature fragment ('Rob') trimmed per the pipeline's own precedent of trimming Google's truncation artifacts; no words changed.

reviews.text: Great services, great timing, i asked and they deliver. Definitively recommended and will workshop with them again
reviews.author: Pavel Diez

reviews.text: They are the best and always very helpful. 1000% recommended, will definitely use them again.
reviews.author: Jennifer Fuentes

reviews.text: I live in Naples, Florida 7 months out of the year and in Massachusetts the remaining of the 12 months. I do not know any contractors in Florida so I had to go on line and pick someone and take a chance on them. I called GCFullServices for a quote and Yeny whom I spoke with was very professional and friendly. She sent me a quote and I accepted it. A few days later she came to my house with her husband Rolando and started the work. I had to replace two walls that got water damage and they did a beautiful job. Not only did they put up new sheet rock, they filled the cracks so no water will get in. I highly recommend them they did a great job, we are very happy with the outcome.
reviews.author: Loretta Perretti
reviews.note: Key source confirming Yeny + Rolando are a husband-and-wife team.

reviews.text: If u want to upgrade your bathroom to other level this is the right company ,they are super professional workers !! Highly recommended !!!
reviews.author: Arg homes remodeling llc

reviews.text: Excellent drywall repair! The patched area is so smooth and seamless, it's virtually impossible to tell there was ever a hole or damage there. The blending into the existing wall is perfect, showing true skill, craftsmanship, and attention to detail. Price was great, compared to other estimates. You cannot go wrong if you choose GCfullservices for any and all handyman work.. give them a try!! You will not be disappointed. I will use them again!!
reviews.author: Dan Lai

reviews.text: GC did a great job repairing damaged interior pocket doors. Came the same day to review and repaired the next day. Work like a charm now. Very reasonable rates as well...Would definitely use them again!
reviews.author: Mark Hebert

reviews.text: I am so happy that I came across GC Full Services. They are excellent workers and their price is fair for the quality they provide. Their moto is: "If you do a job do it right the first time". They are very professional and they explain in details what the job will be. I followed their advices and I am so happy with their services. They are trustworthy, honest and caring people.
reviews.author: Linda Krieser
reviews.note: Source of the 'motto' quote used as the hero/CTA tagline.

reviews.text: Rolando and Yeny did a great job for us patching dry wall in two places and fixing a round hole in our bathroom floor tile. it was not an easy job and we are 100% happy with their work. Meticulous, clean, fast and friendly. Thank you
reviews.author: Christopher Mander

reviews.text: GC did a great job installing insulation, plywood and ladder in our garage attic. They performed on time at quoted price, and left the space cleaner then when they started! I will hire them in the future as needed.
reviews.author: Blair Mahan

build_note: Built by copying templates/light/index.html (the 'Amani' light exemplar named in PIPELINE.md Fase 2) to output/gc-full-services-naples/index.html and editing it section by section: head/JSON-LD, palette tokens (navy-blue, derived from the uniform logo), nav/hero/strip/marquee, 'Nosotros' (About), 'proceso' (renamed from 'ritual', 4 real steps), 'servicios' (4 cards, no prices, 'Se cotiza, escribenos'), gallery (6 real photos, cinematic 1-wide + 5 layout), 'opiniones' (4 real verbatim Google reviews in a carousel), service-area section (adapted variant: no address, no map iframe, replaced with a real in-progress photo; see FORGE-BRIEF 0.b), CTA final and footer, and the floating button (call icon instead of booking icon). Bilingual data-es/data-en added throughout (123 matched pairs) plus the applyLang/localStorage/navigator.language toggle script, since the base template had no bilingual mechanism baked in. Verified: 0 em-dashes, 0 <details> tags, JSON-LD parses, HTML tag nesting balanced (python html.parser), all 7 referenced images exist on disk and decode as valid JPEGs, all v2/v3 design-system markers present (text-shine, orb, glass, btn-3d, reveal, Playfair, merktop-badge, data-es, split-word, sec-num, tile-cap, cursor-ring, foot-mark, heroInner).
